title: Python X.509 chain validation
description: Implement cryptography.x509 chain validation against configured trust anchors. Validate signatures/path to anchor, reject invalid chains and issuer-DN-only authorization, and enforce leaf basicConstraints CA=false plus digitalSignature keyUsage. Add independent tests with committed certificate fixtures or generated known vectors.
